events.headline: TKO (TKO) Raises Guidance As Every Segment Fires At Once

lifecycle.authority: Retained structured Lifecycle authority; Markdown and SQLite not read

providers.reason: Management raised FY26 revenue and EBITDA guidance with every segment contributing; shares rose 4.1% on Sept 2. The Sept 12 boxing event and a Sept 15 dividend record date provide near-term supports.
providers.risk: Forward P/E near 46 leaves little margin for any event or guidance disappointment.
